mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a pattern of lines and symbolized statements that reveals whether it is possible for a given compound statement to be true."

Tautology (abbreviated Taut) is the name of an expression of logical equivalence, a rule of inference that permits the mutual replacement of p by (p v p), and the mutual replacement of p by (p  p).
